resources.name: Marmo-Core Kernel Principles
resources.description: Core architecture notes for a zero-dependency AI Agent Kernel with resource registry, policy gateway, auditability, and least privilege.
resources.input_summary: Task or design question about Marmo-Core architecture.
resources.output_summary: Relevant kernel principles and design constraints.

resources.name: Prompt Injection Threat Model
resources.description: Threat model notes for separating untrusted content from trusted instructions and preventing exfiltration through side-effecting tools.
resources.input_summary: Security review task involving external content, tool output, or agent output.
resources.output_summary: Threat model context and safe handling recommendations.

resources.name: Zero-Dependency Python Package Design
resources.description: Workflow for building Python libraries that use only the standard library at runtime while keeping packaging and CLI ergonomics practical.
resources.input_summary: Python package or CLI implementation request.
resources.output_summary: Step-by-step package structure and runtime dependency guidance.
instructions: Prefer dataclasses, argparse, pathlib, json, and unittest.
Expose a CLI entry point and a Python API backed by the same implementation.

resources.name: Safe Tool Use Review
resources.description: Checklist for reviewing read, write, external, and irreversible side effects before a tool is made available to an agent.
resources.input_summary: Tool metadata, permissions, side effects, and trust level.
resources.output_summary: Safety review guidance and policy questions.
instructions: Treat write, external, and irreversible operations as high risk.
Check that secrets are represented as SecretRef rather than plain text.

resources.name: Read Text File
resources.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from an allowed local path and return its content for inspection or summarization.
resources.input_summary: A local file path inside an allowed workspace.
resources.output_summary: UTF-8 text content and basic file metadata.

resources.name: Run Shell Command
resources.description: Run a bounded shell command in a configured working directory for diagnostics or build verification.
resources.input_summary: Command, working directory, timeout, and optional environment.
resources.output_summary: Exit code, stdout, stderr, and elapsed time.

resources.name: Security Reviewer Agent
resources.description: Specialist agent for reviewing resource metadata, permission boundaries, prompt-injection risk, and external side effects.
resources.input_summary: Resource definitions, policy context, or implementation diff.
resources.output_summary: Structured security findings with severity and recommended fixes.
capabilities_detail: Identify prompt injection and exfiltration risks.

resources.name: Documentation Writer Agent
resources.description: Specialist agent for producing developer-facing README, cookbook, and resource authoring documentation.
resources.input_summary: Feature list, API surface, examples, or resource schema.
resources.output_summary: Concise developer documentation and runnable examples.
